title: Plane and Solid Geometry - Practice Exam
instructions: Answer all 15 questions. You have 60 minutes. Show your work for full credit on short-answer questions.

questions.question: Two similar triangles have corresponding sides in the ratio 3:5. If the smaller triangle has perimeter 24 cm, what is the perimeter of the larger triangle?
Two similar rectangles have areas in the ratio 16:25. What is the ratio of their corresponding sides?
A ring is formed by two concentric circles with radii 10 cm and 6 cm. What is the area of the ring?
A sector of a circle with radius 8 cm has a central angle of 90°. What is the area of the sector?
A cube has side length 5 cm. What is the length of its space diagonal?
A sphere is inscribed in a cube with side length 8 cm. What is the radius of the sphere?
A cube with side 6 cm is inscribed in a sphere. What is the radius of the sphere?
A cylinder has radius 4 cm and height 9 cm. What is its volume?
If two similar figures have areas in the ratio 9:16, then their corresponding sides are in the ratio 3:4.
The surface area of a sphere with radius 5 cm is 50π cm².
The space diagonal of a cube with side s equals s√3.
A circle has radius 12 cm. The arc length of a sector with central angle 60° is _____ cm. (Express your answer in terms of π, e.g., 4π)
The interior angle of a regular hexagon is _____ degrees.
Two similar triangles have corresponding sides in the ratio 2:3. The smaller triangle has area 40 cm². Find the area of the larger triangle. Show your work.
questions.rubric: Award 5 points for correct answer (90 cm²) with clear explanation of ratio of areas = (ratio of sides)²

questions.question: A sphere with radius 6 cm is inscribed in a cube. Find the volume of the cube. Show your work.
questions.rubric: Award 5 points for correct answer (1728 cm³) with clear explanation that diameter = side length, thus side = 12 cm, V = 12³
